display_notes: Official BigModel glm-5.3, high effort, OpenCode 1.18.32: all 89 groups completed (15 Pipeline + 74 SR).
Seed 42, one repeat; Structure-cases continuation and all-cases scoring. Original scores, selected attempts and test verdicts are preserved.
User-supplied USD prices per 1M tokens: input $1.40, output $4.40, cached input $0.26. Billed output includes separately recorded reasoning tokens.

Displayed costs cover selected completed checkpoint inference. Incomplete historical infrastructure attempts and preflight probes are excluded from this comparable total; it is not an account invoice.
